## Checklist

- [ ] Added a changelog fragment (see `changes/README.md`), or no release notes are needed and a maintainer should apply `changelog:skip`.
- [ ] Added tests for the fix or feature.
- [ ] Gave every commit a description below its subject, saying why it is made (see "Commit messages" in `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- [ ] Signed off every commit for the DCO (`git commit -s`).
